Tomorrow: check the audit results (caught or not), the crime pattern and arrests. Uninspected crime in a district hints the Chief was bribed there, so audit such districts next. Rotate audit targets so the Chief can't predict them.

When crime goes uninspected (crime with no arrest), audit that district or the same gang's other districts the next day, since gangs may repeat their bribes. Consider 2 audits once crime appears. Score -21 after Day 1.
